name: Missive
tagline: A consolation build is possible, but the paid product's decisive value sits outside a solo rebuild. For Missive, combine email with internal comments and assignments for a small team. The hard boundary is real-time collaboration, many channels, rules, integrations, and shared-inbox reliability, plus mail infrastructure, integrations, and client polish.
